# RawThoughts

> Software, research and consulting that follow one question: how a person, a model, an organisation or a society with limited knowledge and resources forms a workable picture of reality, acts through it, learns from what follows and keeps agency and accountability as scale and capability grow.



## Start here

- [Engineering without filters](https://rawthoughts.in/index.md) ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/))

- [Make work flow across teams and systems](https://rawthoughts.in/services/index.md): Improve one business workflow through a paid audit, an agreed build and support where needed, with product judgement and hands-on engineering. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/services/))

- [Products](https://rawthoughts.in/products/index.md): Together the products form one system a person runs, with people deciding, and each part except Scope, which brings context from Pale, Weave or both, can also be used alone. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/products/))

- [Thoughts](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/index.md): Each collection follows one question into what decides whether a capability becomes useful work: reaching people, the work AI capacity completes, responsibility in everyday practice and the design behind the products. Single arguments are on the Blog. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/collections/))

- [Blog](https://rawthoughts.in/blog/index.md): Independent arguments about workflows, useful compute, evaluation and the work around a capability. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/blog/))

- [About RawThoughts](https://rawthoughts.in/about/index.md): An applied engineering practice where ideas, systems and operating work inform one another. ([HTML](https://rawthoughts.in/about/))
